competitive_landscape: Hong Kong has one of the world's great ferry cultures — the Star Ferry, franchised Outlying-Islands services, and high-speed PRD ferries to Macau, Zhuhai and Shenzhen. But the fleet is aging and diesel, and the government has a decarbonisation push with new-energy ferry trials underway. A clean foiling premium tier fits a mature, mandate-driven market.

regulatory_note: Marine transport falls under the Marine Department, with a government franchised-ferry decarbonisation programme (new-energy ferry trials) and EPD air-quality goals — a clean-fleet mandate an all-electric foiling service meets directly.
seasonality: The typhoon season (May–Nov) periodically halts ferries on T8 signals; winters are cooler with the NE monsoon. Between weather systems, foiling rides the harbour chop better than displacement craft.

summary: Hong Kong is built on the water: Victoria Harbour, the Outlying Islands and a mature, high-volume ferry network. Pioneer II upgrades the inner-harbour and island routes to fast, smooth, zero-emission service; Quanta-LR's hybrid range opens the Pearl River Delta cross-border corridors as single legs.
tagline: One of the world's great harbour cities — a dense ferry network ready for foiling.
transit_planning: For an authority: a premium, zero-emission tier above the mature ferry network — upgraded inner-harbour and island corridors plus credible PRD cross-border lines — additive to existing services.
